content: He who is of a calm and happy nature will hardly feel the pressure of age, but to him who is of an opposite disposition, youth and age are equally a burden.
author: Plato
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

In Plato's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
